
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/22554886" title="发布于 2026-08-18 19:43">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【Azure APIM】在 Azure API Management 中配置 SSE Transport 的 MCP Server：从 App Service 到 APIM 的一次实践</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>最近我把一个 MCP SSE 服务 Demo 部署到了 Azure App Service，并先用 MCP Inspector 直接连接后端服务做了验证。后端服务本身可以正常响应 MCP 调用。(<em>注：MCP SSE Demo的源码见附录</em>)</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="349" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202608/2127802-20260818192120789-1789918753.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>接下来的目标是：把这个已经可以工作的 MCP SSE Server 接入 Azure API Management（APIM），让 APIM 作为统一入口来透传 MCP 请求。</p>
<h2 id="%E8%83%8C%E6%99%AF%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E7%94%A8-rest-api-%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="9">背景：为什么需要用 REST API 配置</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="11">我参考的是官方文档：<a href="https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/api-management/manage-mcp-servers-rest-api?tabs=bash%2Cbicep#sse-transport" target="_blank" data-href="https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/api-management/manage-mcp-servers-rest-api?tabs=bash%2Cbicep#sse-transport" rel="noopener nofollow">在 API 管理中以编程方式管理 MCP 服务器</a>。文档中提到，APIM 的 MCP Server 可以支持两类透传传输方式：</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="13">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="13"><strong><code>streamable</code></strong>：当前 MCP Streamable HTTP 传输方式。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="14"><strong><code>sse</code></strong>：HTTP + Server-Sent Events 传输方式，需要同时配置 <code>sse</code> 和 <code>message</code> 两个端点。</li>
</ul>
<p>不过在我的 APIM 门户页面里，目前没有看到可以把 Transport Type 设置成 SSE 的 UI 控件，门户上默认显示的是 HTTP 相关配置。</p>
<p>因此这次实验选择直接调用 APIM Management REST API 来创建 MCP API。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83%E4%B8%8E%E7%9B%AE%E6%A0%87%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20">环境与目标架构</h2>
这次环境在 Azure 中国区，几个关键点如下：
<ul dir="auto" data-line="24">
<li dir="auto" data-line="24">后端 MCP SSE 服务：部署在 Azure App Service。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="25">API 网关：Azure API Management。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="26">管理面 endpoint：<code>https://management.chinacloudapi.cn</code>。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="27">APIM Gateway endpoint：<code>https://{apim-name}.azure-api.cn</code>。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="28">MCP Transport：<code>sse</code>。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="29">SSE endpoint：<code>/sse</code>。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="30">Message endpoint：<code>/messages</code>。</li>
</ul>
<p>整体调用链路如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">MCP Inspector
  </span>|
  |  https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">{apim-name}.azure-api.cn/my-mcp-sse/sse</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  v
Azure API Management MCP API
  </span>|
  |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  backend
  v
Azure App Service 上的 MCP SSE Server</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E6%AD%A5%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA-sse-transport-%E7%9A%84-mcp-api" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="46">创建 SSE Transport 的 MCP API</h2>
<p>在创建SSE MCP Server之前，需要先在 APIM 中创建了一个 Backend，Backend ID 为 <code>mcpssebackend01</code>，指向 App Service 的根地址。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="271" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202608/2127802-20260818192552838-2015149658.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>这是因为MCP API 不能只依赖 <code>serviceUrl</code>。对于透传的 MCP SSE Server，需要设置 `backendId'，否则会遇见如下错误。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ValidationError</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">details</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
      {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Either BackendId or MCP tools must be set, but not both for MCP API.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      }
    ]
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>此外，还遇见了另一个问题：API version (<code class="code-line language-json" dir="auto" data-line="73"><span class="hljs-string">2025-09-01-preview</span></code>) 在 Azure 中国区不支持。</p>
<p>错误消息：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">NoRegisteredProviderFound</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">message</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">No registered resource provider found for location 'chinanorth3' and API version '2025-09-01-preview' for type 'service'. The supported api-versions are ... '2024-10-01-preview'.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个错误说明：当前区域和云环境下，Microsoft.ApiManagement/service 还没有注册或开放 2025-09-01-preview。</p>
<p>解决方法是改用错误信息中列出的可用版本，本次测试使用的是 2024-10-01-preview。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>最终，把如下CMD脚本中占位符（<code dir="auto" data-line="99">&lt;your-subscription-id&gt; ，</code><code dir="auto" data-line="99">&lt;your-resource-group&gt; ，</code><code dir="auto" data-line="99">&lt;your-apim-name&gt;）</code>替换为Azure上APIM资源的信息后，就可以直接Windows CMD窗口执行：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>set "SUBSCRIPTION_ID=&lt;your-subscription-id&gt;"
set "RESOURCE_GROUP=&lt;your-resource-group&gt;"
set "APIM_NAME=&lt;your-apim-name&gt;"
set "API_VERSION=2024-10-01-preview"
set "MCP_SERVER_ID=my-mcp-sse"
set "BACKEND_ID=mcpssebackend01"

set "BASE_URL=https://management.chinacloudapi.cn/subscriptions/%SUBSCRIPTION_ID%/resourceGroups/%RESOURCE_GROUP%/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/%APIM_NAME%"

for /f "delims=" %T in ('az account get-access-token --resource https://management.chinacloudapi.cn --query accessToken -o tsv') do set "TOKEN=%T"

set "BODY_FILE=%TEMP%\apim-mcp-body.json"

(
echo {
echo   "properties": {
echo     "type": "mcp",
echo     "path": "my-mcp-sse",
echo     "displayName": "My SSE MCP Server",
echo     "description": "Passthrough MCP server using SSE transport",
echo     "protocols": ["https"],
echo     "backendId": "%BACKEND_ID%",
echo     "mcpProperties": {
echo       "transportType": "sse",
echo       "endpoints": {
echo         "sse": {
echo           "uriTemplate": "/sse"
echo         },
echo         "message": {
echo           "uriTemplate": "/messages"
echo         }
echo       }
echo     }
echo   }
echo }
) &gt; "%BODY_FILE%"

curl -s -X PUT ^
  "%BASE_URL%/apis/%MCP_SERVER_ID%?api-version=%API_VERSION%" ^
  -H "Authorization: Bearer %TOKEN%" ^
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" ^
  -H "If-Match: *" ^
  -d "@%BODY_FILE%"</pre>
</div>
<p>注意：因为调用APIM配置接口需要认证, 所以需要登录到Azure China，以便脚本中的“for /f "delims=" %T in ('az account get-access-token --resource https://management.chinacloudapi.cn --query accessToken -o tsv') do set "TOKEN=%T"” 设置TOKEN。</p>
<p>执行的结果如下图：</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="426" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202608/2127802-20260818193309906-477341528.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%E8%A7%A3%E9%87%8A" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="145">关键配置解释</h3>
<p dir="auto" data-line="147">这段请求体里最关键的是：</p>
<ul dir="auto" data-line="149">
<li dir="auto" data-line="149"><code>type: "mcp"</code>：告诉 APIM 这是一个 MCP 类型的 API。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="150"><code>path: "my-mcp-sse"</code>：决定客户端访问 APIM Gateway 时的路径前缀。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="151"><code>backendId</code>：引用已经创建好的 APIM Backend。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="152"><code>transportType: "sse"</code>：声明后端 MCP Server 使用 SSE Transport。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="153"><code>endpoints.sse.uriTemplate</code>：SSE 事件流端点。</li>
<li dir="auto" data-line="154"><code>endpoints.message.uriTemplate</code>：客户端消息发送端点。</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto" data-line="156">在 APIM 门户中也可以看到已经创建好的 MCP API。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="254" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202608/2127802-20260818194042108-1864233617.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E7%94%A8-mcp-inspector-%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95-apim-mcp-sse" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="163">用 MCP Inspector 测试 APIM MCP SSE</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="165">创建完成后，可以用 MCP Inspector 测试 APIM 暴露出来的 SSE endpoint。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="167">连接地址格式如下：<code class="code-line language-text" dir="auto" data-line="169">https://{apim-name}.azure-api.cn/{mcp-path}/sse</code></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="173">对应本次示例就是：<code class="code-line language-text" dir="auto" data-line="175">https://{apim-name}.azure-api.cn/my-mcp-sse/sse</code></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="173">在中国区Azure上测试APIM MCP Service(SSE)，无法连接到MCP服务。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="304" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202608/2127802-20260818194201096-1247652096.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>测试失败。目前推测还是APIM服务自身的某些设定没有完成，还不能完全支持SSE协议</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="173">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E7%BB%93%E8%AE%BA" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="202">结论</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="204">在 Azure China 环境中，MCP SSE 透传配置可创建，但最终集成测试未通过，说明 APIM 侧对 SSE 仍存在能力限制。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="204">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E9%99%84%E5%BD%95-net-mcp-sse-demo" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="207">附录： .NET MCP SSE Demo</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img id="code_img_closed_dff97701-5c9d-4870-ab1f-b9c3c8d70eab" class="code_img_closed lazyload" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif"><img id="code_img_opened_dff97701-5c9d-4870-ab1f-b9c3c8d70eab" class="code_img_opened lazyload" style="display: none" data-src="http://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_dff97701-5c9d-4870-ab1f-b9c3c8d70eab" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre>using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Threading.Channels;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddCors(options =&gt;
{
    options.AddDefaultPolicy(policy =&gt; policy
        .AllowAnyOrigin()
        .AllowAnyHeader()
        .AllowAnyMethod());
});

var app = builder.Build();
var sessions = new ConcurrentDictionary&lt;string, SseClient&gt;();
var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web)
{
    WriteIndented = false
};

app.UseCors();

app.MapGet("/", () =&gt; Results.Json(new
{
    name = "MCP SSE Demo",
    endpoints = new
    {
        sse = "/sse",
        messages = "/messages?sessionId={sessionId}",
        hello = "/api/hello?name=World",
        add = "/api/add"
    }
}));

app.MapGet("/health", () =&gt; Results.Ok(new { status = "ok", time = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow }));

app.MapGet("/api/hello", (string? name) =&gt; Results.Ok(new
{
    message = $"Hello, {(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ? "World" : name)}!",
    time = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow
}));

app.MapPost("/api/add", (AddRequest request) =&gt; Results.Ok(new
{
    request.A,
    request.B,
    sum = request.A + request.B
}));

app.MapGet("/sse", async (HttpContext context) =&gt;
{
    var sessionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
    var client = new SseClient(Channel.CreateUnbounded&lt;string&gt;());
    sessions[sessionId] = client;

    context.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-cache";
    context.Response.Headers.Connection = "keep-alive";
    context.Response.Headers.ContentType = "text/event-stream";


    // Use a relative message endpoint so reverse proxies/APIM can resolve it
    // against the public MCP SSE URL instead of leaking the backend host.
    var endpoint = $"/messages?sessionId={sessionId}";
        
    context.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-cache, no-transform";
    context.Response.Headers["X-Mcp-Endpoint-Source"] = "relative-v2";
    context.Response.Headers["X-Mcp-Endpoint-Value"] = endpoint;

    Console.WriteLine($"Writing MCP endpoint event: {endpoint}");

    await WriteSseAsync(context.Response, endpoint, "endpoint", context.RequestAborted);

    try
    {
        while (!context.RequestAborted.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var messageAvailable = client.Messages.Reader.WaitToReadAsync(context.RequestAborted).AsTask();
            var heartbeat = Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15), context.RequestAborted);
            var completed = await Task.WhenAny(messageAvailable, heartbeat);

            if (completed == heartbeat)
            {
                await WriteSseAsync(context.Response, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("O"), "ping", context.RequestAborted);
                continue;
            }

            if (!await messageAvailable)
            {
                break;
            }

            while (client.Messages.Reader.TryRead(out var payload))
            {
                await WriteSseAsync(context.Response, payload, "message", context.RequestAborted);
            }
        }
    }
    catch (OperationCanceledException)
    {
        // Client disconnected.
    }
    finally
    {
        sessions.TryRemove(sessionId, out _);
    }
});

app.MapPost("/messages", async (HttpContext context) =&gt;
{
    var sessionId = context.Request.Query["sessionId"].ToString();
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionId) || !sessions.TryGetValue(sessionId, out var client))
    {
        return Results.NotFound(new { error = "Unknown or expired sessionId. Connect to /sse first." });
    }

    JsonNode? rpc;
    try
    {
        rpc = await JsonNode.ParseAsync(context.Request.Body, cancellationToken: context.RequestAborted);
    }
    catch (JsonException ex)
    {
        await client.Messages.Writer.WriteAsync(CreateError(null, -32700, $"Parse error: {ex.Message}"), context.RequestAborted);
        return Results.Accepted();
    }

    if (rpc is not JsonObject request)
    {
        await client.Messages.Writer.WriteAsync(CreateError(null, -32600, "Invalid JSON-RPC request."), context.RequestAborted);
        return Results.Accepted();
    }

    var response = HandleJsonRpc(request);
    if (response is not null)
    {
        await client.Messages.Writer.WriteAsync(response, context.RequestAborted);
    }

    return Results.Accepted();
});

app.Run();

string? HandleJsonRpc(JsonObject request)
{
    var id = request["id"];
    var method = request["method"]?.GetValue&lt;string&gt;();

    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(method))
    {
        return CreateError(id, -32600, "Missing JSON-RPC method.");
    }

    if (method.StartsWith("notifications/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
    {
        return null;
    }

    return method switch
    {
        "initialize" =&gt; CreateResult(id, new JsonObject
        {
            ["protocolVersion"] = "2024-11-05",
            ["capabilities"] = new JsonObject
            {
                ["tools"] = new JsonObject
                {
                    ["listChanged"] = false
                }
            },
            ["serverInfo"] = new JsonObject
            {
                ["name"] = "dotnet-mcp-sse-demo",
                ["version"] = "1.0.0"
            }
        }),
        "tools/list" =&gt; CreateResult(id, BuildToolsList()),
        "tools/call" =&gt; CreateResult(id, CallTool(request["params"] as JsonObject)),
        "resources/list" =&gt; CreateResult(id, new JsonObject { ["resources"] = new JsonArray() }),
        "prompts/list" =&gt; CreateResult(id, new JsonObject { ["prompts"] = new JsonArray() }),
        _ =&gt; CreateError(id, -32601, $"Method not found: {method}")
    };
}

JsonObject BuildToolsList() =&gt; new()
{
    ["tools"] = new JsonArray
    {
        new JsonObject
        {
            ["name"] = "echo",
            ["description"] = "Return the provided text.",
            ["inputSchema"] = new JsonObject
            {
                ["type"] = "object",
                ["properties"] = new JsonObject
                {
                    ["text"] = new JsonObject
                    {
                        ["type"] = "string",
                        ["description"] = "Text to echo."
                    }
                },
                ["required"] = new JsonArray("text")
            }
        },
        new JsonObject
        {
            ["name"] = "server_time",
            ["description"] = "Get the current server UTC time.",
            ["inputSchema"] = new JsonObject
            {
                ["type"] = "object",
                ["properties"] = new JsonObject()
            }
        },
        new JsonObject
        {
            ["name"] = "add",
            ["description"] = "Add two numbers.",
            ["inputSchema"] = new JsonObject
            {
                ["type"] = "object",
                ["properties"] = new JsonObject
                {
                    ["a"] = new JsonObject { ["type"] = "number" },
                    ["b"] = new JsonObject { ["type"] = "number" }
                },
                ["required"] = new JsonArray("a", "b")
            }
        }
    }
};

JsonObject CallTool(JsonObject? parameters)
{
    var name = parameters?["name"]?.GetValue&lt;string&gt;();
    var arguments = parameters?["arguments"] as JsonObject ?? new JsonObject();

    var text = name switch
    {
        "echo" =&gt; arguments["text"]?.GetValue&lt;string&gt;() ?? string.Empty,
        "server_time" =&gt; DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("O"),
        "add" =&gt; Add(arguments),
        _ =&gt; $"Unknown tool: {name}"
    };

    return new JsonObject
    {
        ["content"] = new JsonArray
        {
            new JsonObject
            {
                ["type"] = "text",
                ["text"] = text
            }
        }
    };
}

static string Add(JsonObject arguments)
{
    var a = arguments["a"]?.GetValue&lt;double&gt;() ?? 0;
    var b = arguments["b"]?.GetValue&lt;double&gt;() ?? 0;
    return $"{a} + {b} = {a + b}";
}

string CreateResult(JsonNode? id, JsonNode result)
{
    return new JsonObject
    {
        ["jsonrpc"] = "2.0",
        ["id"] = CloneNode(id),
        ["result"] = result
    }.ToJsonString(jsonOptions);
}

string CreateError(JsonNode? id, int code, string message)
{
    return new JsonObject
    {
        ["jsonrpc"] = "2.0",
        ["id"] = CloneNode(id),
        ["error"] = new JsonObject
        {
            ["code"] = code,
            ["message"] = message
        }
    }.ToJsonString(jsonOptions);
}

static JsonNode? CloneNode(JsonNode? node) =&gt; node is null ? null : JsonNode.Parse(node.ToJsonString());

static async Task WriteSseAsync(HttpResponse response, string data, string? eventName, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
{
    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(eventName))
    {
        await response.WriteAsync($"event: {eventName}\n", cancellationToken);
    }

    var lines = data.Replace("\r\n", "\n", StringComparison.Ordinal).Split('\n');
    foreach (var line in lines)
    {
        await response.WriteAsync($"data: {line}\n", cancellationToken);
    }

    await response.WriteAsync("\n", cancellationToken);
    await response.Body.FlushAsync(cancellationToken);
}

public sealed record AddRequest(double A, double B);

public sealed record SseClient(Channel&lt;string&gt; Messages);</pre>
</div>
